description: Pre-registered attempts of the world-state encoder. Every field of an attempt is fixed before any validation or test origin is scored; an attempt is never re-specified after a result, only superseded by a new id that keeps the old one visible.
rules: Splits are chosen from data coverage only. QCEW county annual averages begin in 1990, so the first origin with two public QCEW years (1990, 1991 at the end of 1992) is 1992.
Test origins end at 2023 because 2024 is the last label year public by the cutoff (QCEW 2024 annual averages 2025-09-30, BEA 2024 county series 2025-12-31).
Every forecaster, including the baselines, sees only values whose declared available_at is on or before the origin; the leakage audit counts violations from the arrays themselves.
The gradient-boosted baseline is fed the same subgraph the encoder sees (seed history and differences, neighbour means, state and nation) and the same training and calibration rows.

Acceptance criteria are those of the component defaults with parameter_bounds replaced by beats_drift_dm and beats_gbdt_dm: the encoder has no structurally interpretable parameters to bound, so the replacement is two strictly harder skill tests, not a weakening.

Compute budget per attempt: 60 minutes wall clock on the shared GB10 (declared here, before running, because every origin refits a neural model and a gradient-boosted model per target). An attempt that exceeds it is recorded as not_run with reason compute_budget.

One attempt at a time per GPU: a fit sharing its GPU with another attempt runs up to twice as slowly, which decides the compute budget rather than the model. Added 2026-09-18 after places v2 was stopped for that reason.

attempts.north_star: Places: beats persistence and a gradient-boosted model on the same inputs for next-year employment, population and establishments across US counties.
attempts.rationale: First assay of the root-readout encoder (typed feature-history tokens, relation-gated message passing, 16 slot queries x 12 top-k sparse passes from the seed, Student-t head, masked-token reconstruction) on the one domain where identity is already clean. The seed-only candidate is the same encoder without the graph, so the selection says whether the subgraph helps on validation before the test is touched.
attempts.expected_limits: no_revision_leakage is expected to FAIL for every target: the panel is the current vintage and QCEW (minor), LAUS and BEA (major) revise; real-time county vintages are not in the catalog, so this attempt cannot validate the process whatever its skill. The test window contains 2020, a common shock that pooled Diebold-Mariano tests treat as thousands of independent draws; test.year_clustered_dm reports the conservative per-year test beside the criterion. Labels are two annual steps ahead of the anchor for QCEW and BEA (the value for t is not public at t-12-31), so persistence is a strong baseline. Migration edges exist only for origins from 2020 and CBSA edges only from 2018, so the graph is geography, state and nation for most training origins.
attempts.registration_note: Registered after a smoke run of the pipeline on origins 2006-2009 (validation 2006-2007, test 2008-2009), all of which are training years of this attempt; no origin in 2014-2023 was scored before this registration was committed. The smoke run led to three changes made before registration: suppressed QCEW cells and BEA zero levels for non-existent areas are excluded from the panel (hence the pinned version), training uses one forward pass per step, and epochs are 4 rather than 6 to fit the declared compute budget.

attempts.north_star: Actors: forecast what an institution does next; beats base rate and a gradient-boosted model on the same inputs.
attempts.rationale: First actors attempt: two quarterly decisions of 13F filers, each a (manager, security) position whose subgraph is the manager, the security, the security's other top holders' positions and the manager's other top positions. Relational by construction: whether co-holders are leaving a security, and what else a manager holds, are exactly what a per-position model cannot see without being told. The seed-only candidate is the same encoder on the query position alone.
attempts.expected_limits: Positions are sampled at most 50 per manager and 8,000 per quarter, so scores describe that sampling, not the population of positions. The pooled Diebold-Mariano test treats tens of thousands of positions as independent within a quarter; test.quarter_clustered_dm is the conservative check beside it. A 13F exit is not necessarily a sale (a position can fall below reporting, be transferred or be reclassified). The 2020 Q1 shock sits in the validation block.
attempts.registration_note: Registered after a smoke run on quarters 2016Q1-2017Q2 (training quarters of this attempt) with a reduced model. The smoke run changed one criterion before registration: calibration is judged by the count-weighted expected calibration error (<= 0.02), because the worst-bin deviation is decided by bins holding a handful of forecasts (the smoke run's worst bin deviated 0.43 while Brier skill was positive).

attempts.north_star: Actors, and the premise under every downstream use: does the world-state embedding add signal to a strong model that already sees the same inputs?
attempts.rationale: Registered after actors v1 was scored: v1's encoder beat the base rate on both tasks and lost to LightGBM on the same template features on both. v2 asks whether the embedding is useful signal for that stronger model. gbdt_plus_self_supervised_embedding: LightGBM on the template features plus 32 principal components (fitted on training rows) of the state vector of an encoder trained on masked reconstruction alone, with no labels: a task-agnostic world-state embedding. gbdt_plus_crossfit_encoder: LightGBM plus the task-trained encoder's logits, cross-fitted over alternating training quarters so no training row is scored by an encoder that saw its label. Beating the declared gbdt baseline is exactly the test of whether the embedding adds signal. The seed-only candidate is dropped: v1 already selected the subgraph over it on validation for both tasks.
attempts.expected_limits: Positions are sampled at most 50 per manager and 8,000 per quarter, so scores describe that sampling, not the population of positions. The pooled Diebold-Mariano test treats tens of thousands of positions as independent within a quarter; test.quarter_clustered_dm is the conservative check beside it. A 13F exit is not necessarily a sale (a position can fall below reporting, be transferred or be reclassified). The 2020 Q1 shock sits in the validation block. The test window is the one v1 was scored on, and this attempt was designed knowing v1's result there; its verdict is conditioned on that choice of candidates. Compute budget 120 minutes (declared here, before running): the cross-fit candidate fits two encoders per block.

attempts.north_star: Actors, in a second domain: forecast what a legislator does next, and test whether the embedding adds signal.
attempts.rationale: A second actor domain, on the same protocol and the same three candidates as actors v2, so the question 'does the world-state embedding add signal to a strong model on the same inputs?' is asked of a different kind of decision. A sample is one member's yea or nay on a party-unity roll call; the label is voting against their own party's majority. The subgraph is the pair, the member, the roll call, the bill's sponsor, the eight members who agreed most with them over the previous two years, and their state delegation: relations a per-member model cannot see. The member's own defection rate over the previous year is a declared baseline, because it is what anyone would use.
attempts.expected_limits: Party-unity votes only, so abstentions and consensus votes produce no samples, and the defection base rate is a few per cent: skill has to come from ranking rare events. Sampling is capped at 40 votes per member per quarter and 8,000 samples per quarter, so scores describe that sample. DW-NOMINATE and roll-call midpoints are excluded because Voteview re-estimates them from later votes; cosponsors are excluded because the published lists carry no dates, which removes the strongest available signal of a bill's bipartisanship. Members who switch party get a new ICPSR id, which resets their history. The test window includes the 117th-118th Congresses; the validation block includes 2020. Compute budget 120 minutes, declared before running.

attempts.north_star: Actors, in a third domain: forecast what an organisation does next, and test whether the world-state embedding adds signal to a strong model that already sees the same inputs.

criteria.note: Declared before running. The FEC bulk pas2 release is a snapshot taken at acquisition and carries no per-transaction filing or amendment date, so an amendment filed into a cycle's own file after that cycle's declared public date (31 January after it ends) cannot be told from the original report. The domain removes the part that is visible -- money whose transaction month falls outside the window of the cycle file carrying it, 650 of 3.23M groups -- and this allowance makes the rest visible in the report instead of hiding it in a False.

attempts.rationale: A third actor domain, on the same runner, the same three candidates and the same question as actors v2, so 'does the world-state embedding add signal to a strong model on the same inputs?' is asked of an organisation's choice rather than a person's vote or a manager's trade. A sample is one (giving committee, recipient candidate committee, cycle) pair that gave in that cycle; the label is a direct contribution to the same recipient in the next cycle. The subgraph is the pair, the giver, the recipient, the giver's eight largest other recipients that cycle and the recipient's eight largest other givers: the bipartite structure a per-pair model cannot see. The giver's own repeat rate into the sample cycle is a declared baseline, because it is what anyone would use. Periods are two-year cycles, so there are only four test cycles: the quarter-clustered test has three degrees of freedom and is weak by construction, which is declared here rather than discovered later.
attempts.expected_limits: Pairs are sampled at most 50 per giving committee and 8,000 per cycle, so scores describe that sampling, not the population of contribution relationships; the pooled Diebold-Mariano test treats thousands of pairs within a cycle as independent, and test.quarter_clustered_dm, over four test cycles, is the conservative check beside it. Giving means a direct contribution, an in-kind contribution or a coordinated party expenditure (24K, 24Z, 24C); independent expenditures and communication costs are features but never the label, because by law they are not coordinated with the candidate. A recipient committee that does not run again is labelled 0, so the task mixes the giver's choice with the candidate's, and a model can score well by forecasting retirements. Roughly 3.9% of pas2 groups carry no recipient committee id and are dropped, as are 2,390 undated groups and 650 reported outside their cycle window. Amendments filed into a cycle's own file after its declared public date cannot be distinguished in this release: no_revision_leakage carries an explicit allowance for that, and a pass on it is not evidence that no revision entered. Committee registration attributes (party, type, mailing state) are read from the cycle's master file, which is itself a snapshot. Cycle 2026 is incomplete at the pinned version and is never a sample or a feature. Compute budget 120 minutes, declared before running.

attempts.north_star: Actors, in a fourth domain: forecast a balance sheet turning, and test whether the world-state embedding adds signal to a strong model that already sees the same inputs.

criteria.note: Declared before running. The FDIC financials API serves one value per bank, report date and field, with no filing date and no amendment flag, so an amended call report cannot be told from the original. The 13F domain excludes amendments because that source marks them; here there is nothing to exclude on, and this allowance makes the risk visible in the report instead of hiding it in a False.

distress_marker.noncurrent_ratio: bank_noncurrent_loans / bank_net_loans, both as the FDIC publishes them
distress_marker.noncurrent_onset: the ratio is above 0.03 at q+1 and at or below 0.03 at q
distress_marker.deposit_outflow: deposits at q+1 are below 0.90 times deposits at q
distress_marker.label: 1 when either component fires

attempts.rationale: A fourth actor domain, on the same runner, the same three candidates and the same question as actors v2. A sample is one (bank, quarter); the label is a declared distress marker in the next quarter's call report -- a noncurrent-loan ratio crossing 3% from at-or-below, or deposits falling more than 10% in a quarter. The marker is a crossing rather than a level, so an already-impaired bank does not carry a label of 1 forever, and the two components fire at roughly 1.6% and 1.2% of bank-quarters. The subgraph is the bank, up to eight other banks chartered in its state (the largest by assets) and up to eight banks nationally nearest to it in log assets, with the size ratio as the edge weight: a peer structure a per-bank model cannot see. The bank's own marker rate over the previous eight quarters is a declared baseline, because it is what anyone would use.
attempts.expected_limits: The distress marker is a declared label, not a supervisory determination: it is not a failure, a closure, a consent order or a CAMELS downgrade, and no result here says anything about those. bank_net_loans is net of the allowance for credit losses, so the noncurrent ratio runs slightly above a gross-loan ratio and the 3% threshold is declared against the published quantity. The deposit component is seasonal (first-quarter rates run highest), which a model can exploit without knowing anything about banks. Coverage begins at 2010Q1, so the 2008-2009 failures are outside the panel entirely and nothing here is evidence about a crisis. Amended call reports cannot be distinguished from original ones in this release, so a quarter may be represented by a restatement published after its origin: no_revision_leakage carries an explicit allowance for that, and a pass on it is not evidence that no revision entered. Samples are conditioned on the bank filing again next quarter, so a charter that disappears between quarters -- through failure or merger -- leaves no sample, which removes the most severe outcome from the target. Ratios whose denominator can be near zero are clipped at 10,000 before the half-precision cast. The pooled Diebold-Mariano test treats thousands of banks within a quarter as independent; test.quarter_clustered_dm over 16 test quarters is the conservative check beside it. Compute budget 120 minutes, declared before running.

not_run.detail: Stopped at 29 minutes of wall clock on the shared home GB10 after three of four validation origins (fits of 219-250 s for the full encoder and 42-194 s for the seed-only one, slowed by other jobs on the machine), a pace that projected about 64 minutes against the declared 60. No validation score, selection or test forecast had been computed or printed when it was stopped, and nothing was published.

Stopped after one validation origin (full encoder 411 s, seed-only 55 s) because it shared the GPU of gb10-direct with actors.13f_exit_increase_v1, a pace that projected about 64 minutes against 60. No validation score, selection or test forecast had been computed when it was stopped.
